subject: Redwood Inference — Discovery recap & vendor setup next steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Jordan Carter <jordan.carter@stellarapps.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood Inference — Discovery recap & vendor setup next steps

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and a clear path to procurement: 

- Use case: real-time inference for customer support routing (priority: latency under 120ms p95).
- Target environment: Dedicated capacity for production (initial 2 GPU pool, scale to 6 over 6 months).
- Compliance: SOC2 + VPC peering for production traffic.
- Pricing model: committed throughput + overage; I shared the draft SOW/estimate during the call.

Next steps I proposed:
1) I’ll kick off vendor onboarding with finance & ops (W-9 / ACH details) and share the portal invite — should be quick once W-9 is on file.
2) Your procurement team and our finance ops will finalize the PO and vendor profile.
3) Pilot timeline: 2–3 weeks after vendor setup.

Can you confirm procurement priority and whether ACH or vendor payment by invoice is required on your side? If ACH is acceptable, we’ll push for a faster onboarding path. I attached my typed notes from the call.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (summary of today's call, internal)
